findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 8 in the same format as Chapter 1 (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 73 questions numbered 1-73; by section: 8.1 9, 8.2 4, 8.3 5, 8.4 8, 8.5 20, 8.6 15, 8.7 12.

Covers sections 8.1-8.7 in order; comparison questions are answered as two-column tables; small numericals use values changed from the book's examples and were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed: tan(theta_p) = n2/n1 from n1 sin(theta_p) = n2 cos(theta_p); reflected light polarized perpendicular to the plane of incidence; first GW detection (2015) from merging black holes; GW amplitude is a unitless strain; 1 LY = 9.46 x 10^12 km; 'inspiral'.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
